items.brief:
## Product: SecurePayGo
## Problem: UK/EU consumers face fragmented payment experiences; 43% mobile payment failures due to inadequate auth/KYC; CHAPS requires manual intervention in 68% of cases; £4.2M avg annual compliance fines
## Users:
- Retail Payment Users: fast secure payments with biometric auth, payment status across FPS/BACS/SEPA/CHAPS, low cross-border fees
- Business Payment Users: same-day CHAPS from mobile, bulk scheduling, reconciliation, multi-user RBAC
- High-Net-Worth Individuals: enhanced biometric SCA, immediate confirmation, PEP-compliant verification
- Vulnerable Customers: WCAG 2.1 AA, text-to-speech, simplified flows, debt advice signposting
- Compliance Officers: real-time KYC dashboard, automated PEP/sanctions screening, audit logs, DSAR, SAR workflow
- Customer Support Agents: payment history, failed payment reason codes, re-auth trigger, fraud escalation, DISP complaint logging
## Capabilities:
- Initiate payments across FPS, BACS, SEPA, CHAPS from mobile
- Biometric SCA (fingerprint + facial recognition) with PSD2 dynamic linking
- Full KYC/CDD with document verification, liveness detection, PEP screening
- Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) for high-risk customers
- Confirmation of Payee (CoP) before payment execution
- Real-time payment status tracking across all schemes
- Cross-border SEPA payments with transparent FX
- CHAPS high-value same-day payments (>£250K)
- Bulk payment scheduling and templates
- Multi-user access with role-based permissions
- Payee management (add, verify, trust)
- Transaction categorisation and search
- Payment reconciliation and audit trail
- Push notifications for payment status changes
- In-app secure messaging for support
## Quality Expectations:
- 95% SCA success rate
- Sub-3-second payment initiation
- 99.95% uptime
- App cold start < 2s
- API p95 < 500ms
## Constraints:
- PSD2 SCA with dynamic linking (non-negotiable)
- MLR 2017 CDD/EDD requirements
- FCA Consumer Duty compliance
- GDPR (data minimisation, DSAR within 30 days)
- Payment scheme rules: FPS, BACS, SEPA, CHAPS
- CHAPS membership onboarding: 6-9 months
- SEPA requires euro-denominated account infrastructure
- Budget: TBC
- Timeline: MVP within 6 months
## Integrations:
- Payment schemes: FPS, BACS, SEPA, CHAPS (outbound, payment initiation)
- KYC provider: Onfido or equivalent (bidirectional, identity verification)
- Credit reference agency (inbound, credit checks for CHAPS)
- Sanctions/PEP screening service (inbound, compliance checks)
- Open Banking APIs (PISP) (outbound, account access)
- SMS gateway (outbound, OTP delivery)
- Push notification service / FCM (outbound, alerts)
- Confirmation of Payee API (outbound, payee verification)
## Data Entities:
- Customer profile: name, DOB, address, nationality, email, phone — PII=true
- Identity documents: passport, driving licence, utility bills — PII=true
- Payment transactions: amount, currency, status, timestamps — PII=false
- Payee records: name, sort code, account number, IBAN — PII=true
- KYC records: verification status, risk score, PEP flag — PII=true
- Audit logs: all actions, timestamps, user IDs — PII=false
## Success Metrics:
- SCA success rate: 95%
- Payment initiation time: < 3 seconds
- KYC pass rate: > 85% first attempt
- APP fraud rate: < 0.01%
- Customer satisfaction (NPS): > 50
- Regulatory compliance: 0 material findings
## Risks:
- CHAPS membership timeline (6-9 months) may delay MVP
- KYC provider availability affects onboarding flow
- PSD2 dynamic linking implementation complexity
- Cross-border SEPA latency and settlement times
- Regulatory change (FCA/PRA) during build
- APP fraud liability under new PSR rules
## MVP Boundary:
- In: FPS payments, biometric SCA, basic KYC (CDD), CoP, single-user retail, payment status, push notifications
- Out: CHAPS (Phase 2), SEPA cross-border (Phase 2), bulk payments (Phase 3), multi-user/RBAC (Phase 3), EDD (Phase 2), reconciliation (Phase 2)
## Open Questions:
- Direct vs indirect CHAPS membership? (cost/timeline implications)
- Which KYC provider? (Onfido, Jumio, iProov)
- Sponsor bank for payment scheme access?
- FX provider for SEPA euro conversion?
- On-premise vs cloud HSM for key management?
